<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><meta name="theme-color" content="#0a0b0e"><title>STEPBACK STUDIO — 多塔建筑实验室 · 预览修复</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#080a0d;--panel:#101217;--panelHi:#151920;--line:#252a32;--text:#f5f7fa;--sub:#97a0ac;--muted:#68727d;--accent:#d0e5ff;--blue:#95bbdf;--rad:12px;--left:294px;--right:275px;--bottom:106px}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:13px/1.45 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Display','PingFang SC','Microsoft Yahei',sans-serif}button,input,select{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer;color:inherit}button:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}::selection{background:#627c96}
#app{height:100dvh;min-height:430px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:var(--left) minmax(220px,1fr) var(--right);grid-template-rows:64px minmax(0,1fr) var(--bottom);gap:0;background:var(--bg)}
header{grid-column:1/4;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 21px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:#0b0d10;z-index:5}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px}.mark{width:31px;height:31px;border:1px solid #99abb8;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2c3843,#111319);font-weight:750;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-3px;padding-right:3px;color:#eff6ff}.brandname{font-weight:720;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.13em}.brandsub{color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;margin-top:2px;letter-spacing:.025em}.hcenter{display:flex;gap:4px;background:#15181d;padding:4px;border:1px solid #272c33;border-radius:11px}.seg{background:none;border:0;border-radius:7px;padding:8px 14px;color:#999faa;font-size:11px}.seg.active{color:#121518;background:#e7edf3;font-weight:650}.hright{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.tag{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:7px 9px;font-size:10px;color:#b8c0c9;border:1px solid #282e36;border-radius:7px}.dot{width:6px;height:6px;background:#8fc6a8;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 7px #8fc6a857}.button{background:#232831;border:1px solid #373e49;border-radius:9px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:11px;transition:background .18s}.button:hover{background:#353e49}.primary{color:#121820;background:#e5edf4;border-color:#e5edf4;font-weight:650}.primary:hover{background:#fff}.iconbtn{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;background:#1b2028;border:1px solid #333b46;color:#c5d2df;width:31px;height:31px;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px}.iconbtn:hover{background:#313844}

#313945;border-radius:10px;background:#161a21;margin-top:9px}.towerrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:9px}.towerdot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#9cc7e9;display:inline-block;margin-right:8px}.minigrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr #stage{grid-column:2;grid-row:2;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 55% 37%,#29313c 0%,#19212c 39%,#0d121b 89%);min-height:0}#view{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;outline:none;touch-action:none}#stage:before{pointer-events:none;content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#00000028,transparent 19%,transparent 74%,#050a0d80);z-index:1}.hud{position:absolute;z-index:3;pointer-events:none}.hud>*{pointer-events:auto}.stage-top{left:22px;right:22px;top:20px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px}.projectname{font-size:16px;font-weight:660;letter-spacing:-.015em;text-shadow:0 1px 12px #0006}.projectcaption{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#c0cad3b5;margin-top:4px}.pill{border:1px solid #ffffff24;background:#101722a8;backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 11px;font-size:10px;color:#e0e8ef}.floater{display:flex;gap:5px;background:#0e141fc2;border:1px solid 12px;border-radius:7px}.viewbtn.active,.viewbtn:hover{background:#d9e6f2;color:#101820}.stage-left{left:19px;bottom:20px;display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:flex-end}.toolpanel{display:grid;gap:5px;padding:5px;background:#101620b8;border:1px solid #fff2;border-radius:10px;backdrop-filter:blur(18px)}.viewSquare{background:none;border:0;color:#cad6e0;width:35px;height:35px;border-radius:7px;font-size:14px}.viewSquare:hover{background:#ffffff2c}.stage-right{right:20px;bottom:24px;text-align:right}.axis{display:inline-flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;color:#dbe4ed;font-size:10px}.axis i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block}.scale{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#d6dfeb8d}#loading{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;z-index:8;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,#101925e8,#090d15f2);text-align:center}#loading.hidden{display:none}.load-inner{max-width:340px;padding:28px}.spinner{width:34px;height:34px;border:2px solid #536270;border-top-color:#e9f4ff;border-radius:50%;animation:spin .8s linear infinite;margin:0 auto 21px}@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}.load-title{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.02em;font-weight:600}.load-desc{font-size:11px;line-height:1.8;color:#9caabb;margin-top:9px;white-space:pre-line}.errorbtn{display:none;margin:18px auto 0}.error #loadretry{display:block}.error .spinner{display:none}
#bottom{grid-column:2;grid-row:3;background:#101318;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:13px 24px;z-index:3}.timehead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;color:#e4e9ee;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:11px}.timehead strong{font-size:11px}.timeline{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px}.timeline input{flex:1;min-width:30px}.footstats{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:13px;color:#707d8c;font-size:10px;gap:12px}.kbd{border:1px solid #465161;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 5px;color:#b3bccc;font-size:9px}
.right-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}.stat{background:#181c24;border:1px solid #292f39;padding:13px;border-radius:9px}.stat .big{font-size:23px;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:#eff2f6;font-weight:570;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.stat .cap{color:#808d9b;font-size:10px;margin-top:5px}.layer{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #242a32;font-size:10px}.layer b{font-size:11px;font-weight:540;color:#bdc7d2;flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.layer small{font-size:10px;color:#6e7d89}.layer input{accent-color:#b5d1e9}.detail{font-size:11px;color:#9da9b7;line-height:1.75;min-height:72px}.minirow{display:flex;gap:7px}.minirow>*{flex:1}.footerbrand{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#586574;padding:20px}
#toast{position:absolute;z-index:15;left:50%;bottom:18px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#e7eef5;color:#121820;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 15px;font-size:11px;font-weight:570;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s;white-space:nowrap}#toast.show{opacity:1}
#splitL,#splitR{position:absolute;top:64px;bottom:0;width:7px;z-index:9;cursor:col-resize}#splitL{left:calc(var(--left) - 4px)}#splitR{right:calc(var(--right) - 4px)}#splitL:hover,#splitR:hover{background:#9fb9d42c}
@media(max-width:1090px){:root{--right:240px;--left:265px}.hright .tag{display:none}.stage-top .floater{display:none}}@media(max-width:800px){:root{--left:240px;--right:0px}#right,#splitR{display:none}.hcenter{display:none}#app{grid-template-columns:var(--left) minmax(200px,1fr) 0}header{padding:0 14px}}@media(max-width:570px){:root{--left:0px;--bottom:103px}#left,#splitL{display:none}#app{grid-template-columns:0 minmax(0,1fr) 0}.brandname{font-size:11px}.brandsub{font-size:9px}.stage-top{top:13px;left:13px;right:13px}.stage-left{left:10px;bottom:12px}#bottom{padding:12px}.footstats{font-size:9px}}
</style><script type="importmap">{"imports":{"three":"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js","three/addons/":"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"}}</script></head><body>
<div id="app"><header><div class="brand"><div class="mark">S</div><div><div class="brandname">STEPBACK <span style="font-weight:350;color:#8797a9">STUDIO</span></div><div class="brandsub">多塔参数化建筑实验室 <span style="color:#485666">/</span> 04.1</div></div></div><div class="hcenter"><button id="realTab" class="seg active">Rhino 原始模型</button><button id="paramTab" class="seg">参数化生成</button></div><div class="hright"><div class="tag"><i class="dot"></i><span id="headStatus">初始化三维引擎</span></div><button class="button" id="saveImg">导出画面</button><button class="button primary" id="exportModel">导出模型 · GLB</button></div></header>
<aside id="left"><div class="pane-head"><div class="eyebrow">MODEL LAB / 04</div><div class="pane-title" id="leftTitle">真实模型控制台</div><div class="pane-desc" id="leftDesc">直接读取你上传的 Rhino 8 .3dm，保留源文件的实际几何关系。</div></div>
<div id="realControls"><section class="sec"><div class="stitle">源文件 <span class="meta">已嵌入 HTML</span></div><div class="field"><div class="labelrow"><label>Rhino 原始几何</label><span style="color:#87c8af;font-size:10px">● 已附带</span></div><div style="font-size:11px;color:#e4eaf2;background:#171c24;padding:12px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid #2b333d;overflow-wrap:anywhere">多塔建筑连接测试(1).3dm</div><div class="hint">原始 3DM 数据嵌入单文件中，无需另选模型文件。</div></div><button id="reloadRhino" class="button" style="width:100%">重新读取 Rhino 模型</button></section>
<section class="sec"><div class="stitle">模型显示</div><div class="field"><div class="labelrow"><label>建筑呈现方式</label></div><select class="input" id="realMat"><option value="original">原始材质优化</option><option value="ceramic">哑光陶瓷建筑白模</option><option value="glass">蓝灰玻璃分析</option><option value="graphite">深灰结构模型</option></select></div><div class="switchrow">显示地面与网格<button class="toggle on" id="gridToggle" aria-label="切换网格"></button></div><div class="switchrow">投射柔和阴影<button class="toggle on" id="shadowToggle" aria-label="切换阴影"></button></div><div class="switchrow">曲线 / 辅助构件<button class="toggle on" id="linesToggle" aria-label="切换辅助线"></button></div></section>
<section class="sec"><div class="stitle">真实几何装配 <span class="meta">截面裁切</span></div><div class="field"><div class="labelrow"><label>高度显示</label><span class="value" id="cutOut">100%</span></div><input class="range" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="100" id="realCut"><div class="hint">按模型实际 Z 高度逐渐显示，不会改变原始几何。</div></div></section></div>
<div id="paramControls" style="display:none"><section class="sec"><div class="stitle">形态参数 <span class="meta">基于 GH v25.50 规则</span></div><div class="field" data-control="floorHeight"><div class="labelrow"><label>楼层高度 UnitZ</label><span class="value" id="floorHeightO">3.60 m</span></div><input class="range" id="floorHeight" type="range" min="2.6" max="6" value="3.6" step=".1"></div><div class="field" data-control="thickness"><div class="labelrow"><label>楼板厚度</label><span class="value" id="thicknessO">0.42 m</span></div><input class="range" id="thickness" type="range" min=".18" max="1.2" value=".42" step=".02"></div><div class="field" data-control="setback"><div class="labelrow"><label>逐层退台 Step</label><span class="value" id="setbackO">0.32 m</span></div><input class="range" id="setback" type="range" min="0" max=".9" value=".32" step=".02"></div><div class="field"><div class="labelrow"><label>有机随机度 Randomness</label><span class="value" id="randomO">25%</span></div><input class="range" id="random" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="25"></div><div class="field"><div class="labelrow"><label>参考线吸引强度</label><span class="value" id="attachO">46%</span></div><input class="range" id="attach" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="46"></div><div class="field"><div class="labelrow"><label>随机种子 Seed</label><input id="seed" class="input small" type="number" value="42" min="0" max="99999"></div></div></section>
<section class="sec"><div class="stitle">塔楼与楼层 <span class="meta">独立设置</span></div><div id="towerInputs"></div><button id="addTower" class="button" style="width:100%;margin-top:10px">＋ 添加塔楼</button></section><section class="sec"><div class="stitle">楼板连接 / Bridge</div><div class="field"><div class="labelrow"><label>指定连接楼层</label><span class="value">楼层编号</span></div><input id="connections" class="input" value="5,6,10" placeholder="例如 5,6 或 10-12"><div class="hint">输入 56 即第 56 层；5,6 表示第 5、6 层。超出塔楼高度时跳过连接。</div></div><div class="field"><div class="labelrow"><label>连接宽度 BridgeWaviness</label><span class="value" id="bridgeWidthO">1.00×</span></div><input id="bridgeWidth" type="range" class="range" min=".45" max="1.7" step=".05" value="1"></div><div class="modeNote">网页版以独立 JavaScript 实现 GH 的主要控制规则；它不是 RhinoCommon 原算法的精确替代。复杂多塔布尔并集需要在 Rhino 中复核。</div></section></div><div class="footerbrand">STEPBACK PARAMETRIC ARCHITECTURE © 2026</div></aside>
<section id="stage"><canvas id="view" tabindex="0"></canvas><div class="hud stage-top"><div><div class="projectname" id="projectName">多塔建筑 · 原始 Rhino 模型</div><div class="projectcaption" id="projectCaption">PROJECT 01 / RHINO 8 / 真实几何</div></div><div class="floater"><button class="viewbtn active" data-view="iso">轴测</button><button class="viewbtn" data-view="top">顶视</button><button class="viewbtn" data-view="front">正视</button><button class="viewbtn" data-view="right">侧视</button></div></div><div class="hud stage-left"><div class="toolpanel"><button id="fitView" class="viewSquare" title="完整显示">⌖</button><button id="zoomIn" class="viewSquare" title="放大">＋</button><button id="zoomOut" class="viewSquare" title="缩小">－</button><button id="resetRotation" class="viewSquare" title="重置视角">↺</button></div></div><div class="hud stage-right"><div class="axis"><i style="background:#d99088"></i>X&nbsp;&nbsp;<i style="background:#93bfb1"></i>Y&nbsp;&nbsp;<i style="background:#9dbee4"></i>Z</div><div class="scale">单位：米 / 左键旋转 · 右键平移 · 滚轮缩放</div></div><div id="loading"><div class="load-inner"><div class="spinner"></div><div class="load-title" id="loadTitle">读取真实建筑模型</div><div class="load-desc" id="loadDesc">正在初始化 Rhino / WebGL 三维几何引擎…</div><button class="button primary errorbtn" id="loadretry">切换参数化预览</button></div></div><div id="toast"></div></section>
<aside id="right"><div class="pane-head"><div class="eyebrow">MODEL INSPECTOR</div><div class="pane-title">建筑信息</div><div class="pane-desc">实时构件检查、模型层级和显示控制。</div></div><section class="sec"><div class="stitle">三维统计<span class="meta" id="statsTag">计算中</span></div><div class="right-stats"><div class="stat"><div class="big" id="objCount">—</div><div class="cap" id="objCap">模型构件</div></div><div class="stat"><div class="big" id="heightCount">—</div><div class="cap">建筑高度 · m</div></div><div class="stat"><div class="big" id="faceCount">—</div><div class="cap">网格三角形</div></div><div class="stat"><div class="big" id="bridgeCount">—</div><div class="cap">连接层（参数模式）</div></div></div></section><section class="sec"><div class="stitle">显示模式</div><div class="minirow"><button id="displayReal" class="button primary">真实感</button><button id="displayWhite" class="button">白模</button><button id="displayLines" class="button">线框</button></div><div style="margin-top:13px"><select id="lighting" class="input"><option value="day">明亮工作室</option><option value="dusk">日落柔光</option><option value="night">夜间建筑</option></select></div></section><section class="sec"><div class="stitle">模型图层 <span class="meta" id="layerCount">—</span></div><div id="layerList"><div class="smalltxt">载入模型后显示层级</div></div></section><section class="sec"><div class="stitle">选中构件 <button class="iconbtn" id="clearSelect" title="清除选择">×</button></div><div class="detail" id="selection">单击三维模型中的构件，查看名称、几何类型与位置。</div></section><section class="sec"><div class="stitle">工程文件</div><div class="minirow"><button id="exportJson" class="button">导出参数</button><button id="saveGH" class="button">原始 GH</button></div><div class="modeNote">原始 .3dm 与 .gh 均已嵌入此 HTML。首次联网获取三维解码库；几何数据无需上传至第三方服务器。</div></section></aside>
<div id="bottom"><div class="timehead"><div><strong>建筑装配过程</strong> <span style="color:#7e8c99;margin-left:9px" id="timelineMode">真实模型高度裁切</span></div><span id="timelinePct" style="font-size:11px;color:#a9b8c5">100%</span></div><div class="timeline"><button id="play" class="iconbtn" title="播放 / 暂停">▶</button><button id="prev" class="iconbtn" title="上一步">‹</button><input id="progress" type="range" class="range" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="100"><button id="next" class="iconbtn" title="下一步">›</button><select id="speed" class="input" style="width:79px;height:31px"><option value=".5">0.5×</option><option selected value="1">1×</option><option value="2">2×</option><option value="4">4×</option></select></div><div class="footstats"><span id="timelineDetail">源文件几何保持不变</span><span><span class="kbd">左键</span> 旋转 &nbsp; <span class="kbd">Shift</span> 平移 &nbsp; <span class="kbd">1 / 2 / 3</span> 视图</span></div></div></div><div id="splitL"></div><div id="splitR"></div>
<script id="model-data" type="application/octet-stream">
